rounds.text: Sadhav Shipping exhibits concerning signs of internal instability and operational inefficiency that undermine its long-term investment case. Despite reporting profits, the company fails to return any value to shareholders through dividends [E4, E48]. The quality of these earnings is further brought into question by a significant increase in debtor days from 68.1 to 84.7, suggesting difficulties in collecting payments [E51]. Furthermore, the company’s operating margins have compressed by 3 percentage points over the last three years, and the trend remains inconsistent [E18, E20]. The reduction in promoter holdings by 7.66 percentage points since March 2024 signals a potential lack of long-term confidence from those closest to the business [E29]. Finally, the stock carries extreme risk, evidenced by a historical peak-to-trough drawdown of -68.6% and high annualized volatility of 50.6% [E41, E42]. Conceded: the company maintains a comfortable current ratio of 2.11x and has successfully reduced debt [E26, E47].
